post_change_quote_pair_count_screen.interpretation: A count mismatch is a locator, not by itself an error: German and target text can differ in segmentation or omit a passage, and some German source lines use mixed opening/closing glyphs. Each candidate must be compared semantically before changing wording. Existing absent target bodies and missing passages were not created by this quote-style operation.
